The '''kyber dart''' was a projectile toxic dart produced by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], and saw use during the [[Dark Wars]].

==History==
The Kaminoans had an intimate knowledge of genetic engineering and xenobiology, which allowed them to develop the biotoxins used in the kyber dart. These cone-shaped weapons could kill with lethal efficiency. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mira]], known to operate on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] following the [[Jedi Civil War]], carried an arsenal of kyber darts, fired from a wrist-mounted dart launcher.<ref name="KOTOR II">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|Kamino saberdart]] seen in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']] was known as a "Kamino kyberdart" in the film's shooting script.<ref name="CoD Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/cargo-of-doom-trivia-gallery|text="Cargo of Doom" Trivia Gallery}}</ref> The prefix "kyber" has its roots in an unused concept created for [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']]: the Kiber Crystal,<ref name="AotS">''[[Adventures of the Starkiller, Episode I: The Star Wars]]''</ref><ref name="FAoLTS">''[[The Star Wars: From The Adventures of Luke Starkiller]]''</ref> which eventually became the [[Kaiburr crystal]] seen in ''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''.<ref name="SotME">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>
